plugin.aes.title: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard)
plugin.aes.param.keyHint: 16, 24 or 32 bytes as hex digits (AES-128, -192 or -256); spaces and colons are ignored.
plugin.aes.param.plaintextHint: Exactly one 16-byte block as hex digits; spaces and colons are ignored.
plugin.aes.param.detailHint: Step through every single operation or through whole rounds.
plugin.aes.step.input: The 16 input bytes are written into the 4×4 state, column by column.
plugin.aes.step.keyExpansion: KeyExpansion stretches the {{keyWords}}-word key into {{words}} words: one 4-word round key per round plus one.
plugin.aes.step.addRoundKey: Round {{round}}: the state is XORed byte by byte with round key {{roundKey}}.
plugin.aes.step.subBytes: Round {{round}}: every byte is replaced through the S-box.
plugin.aes.step.shiftRows: Round {{round}}: row r of the state rotates r positions to the left.
plugin.aes.step.mixColumns: Round {{round}}: each column is multiplied by a fixed matrix in GF(2^8), mixing its four bytes.
plugin.aes.step.invSubBytes: Round {{round}}: every byte is replaced through the inverse S-box.
plugin.aes.step.invShiftRows: Round {{round}}: row r of the state rotates r positions back to the right.
plugin.aes.step.invMixColumns: Round {{round}}: each column is multiplied by the inverse MixColumns matrix.
plugin.aes.step.output: The final state is read out column by column as the output block.
plugin.aes.step.roundInitial: Round 0: the input block is loaded and XORed with round key {{roundKey}}.
plugin.aes.step.round: Round {{round}} done: SubBytes, ShiftRows, MixColumns and AddRoundKey.
plugin.aes.step.roundFinal: Round {{round}} (final) done: SubBytes, ShiftRows and AddRoundKey, without MixColumns.
plugin.aes.step.invRound: Inverse round {{round}} done: InvShiftRows, InvSubBytes, AddRoundKey and InvMixColumns.
plugin.aes.step.invRoundFinal: Inverse round {{round}} (final) done: InvShiftRows, InvSubBytes and AddRoundKey.
plugin.aes.error.invalidParams: AES needs a key and a plaintext, both given as hex text.
plugin.aes.error.keyLength: The key has {{length}} bytes; AES needs 16, 24 or 32 bytes.
plugin.aes.error.plaintextLength: The plaintext has {{length}} bytes; one AES block is exactly 16 bytes.
